name: Shi Ling - Er
source:
After investigating a real criminal case, our protagonist finally knows how to use his powers, but the real challenge has not yet come.

[From [url=https://polyxyz.itch.io/vision-ghost-2-prologue]Itch.io[/url]]

調查過一樁真實刑事案件之後，主角終於明白了該如何運用自己的能力。然而，真正的挑戰尚未到來。
